name: stripe
description: Multi-platform Stripe checkout and webhook scaffold (web, API, mobile, desktop, WordPress)
features: Env wiring scoped per platform: secret keys only in the API and web server routes
Express and FastAPI server SDK stubs
POST /stripe/checkout-session in FastAPI and Express APIs (price allowlist, redirect URLs limited to configured origins)
Desktop: no secret keys; Electron opens API-created Checkout via main + IPC, Tauri gets the publishable key only
WordPress plugin scaffold for WooCommerce-style checkout hooks
envVarsNote: Keyed by platform. Secret keys appear only under server-side apps (api, web server routes); desktop and mobile apps get a publishable key or nothing. src/commands/addons/stripe.ts writes the matching block into each app's .env.example.
note: Harvested from ngineeringos build.addon.stripe; ngos owns judgment, gpp owns files.
